_comment: packages/domain-ts/src/notificationParser.ts. Both suites load this file and
Vitest cannot import from outside webapp/, so this file is duplicated to
Both suites assert the two copies are byte-identical; if that fails, copy
Messages follow the shapes Indian banks and UPI apps actually send, with
every account digit, reference number, name and amount made up. Replace
or extend them with anonymised real alerts from your own phone: a real
`expect: null` means the parser must reject the message. Otherwise only
the keys present are asserted. Amounts are compared as Decimal strings,
`now` is local wall-clock time with no offset, so both languages read it
